method: built-in imagegen edits; visual concepts, not renderer output

prompts.fall:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: C3X Renderer Lab seasonal concept scene.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an actual standalone summer renderer capture of test.biq. Edit this exact full scene, maintaining the same 16:9 image extent, orthographic isometric camera, map geometry, identical tree cluster positions and individual tree types, mountain and hill shapes, river paths and widths, coastline silhouette, ocean, exposed rock areas and distant buildings. It must still look like the same stylized Civilization strategy game renderer screenshot, with its current texture detail and resolution. Do not redesign the scene or turn it into a painting. No added objects, trees, cities, sky, terrain elevations, roads, bridges, snowfall particles, text, labels, frames, HUD, logo, or watermark. Keep calm clear noon lighting, the same shadow direction and lengths, and readable terrain. Change seasonal surface materials and foliage only. Keep the large ocean and winding rivers liquid blue and preserve their exact paths.
Primary request: Make a FALL version of this exact summer view. Grassland becomes a little drier and olive brown, with grassy surface detail still visible. Plains remains distinct as warm straw tan; preserve the warm sandy desert along the upper edge. Existing deciduous leafy trees become a varied but restrained mix of golden yellow, warm amber, orange and a few russet accents. Keep the existing dark evergreen pines green. Add only sparse subtle brown leaf litter beneath the existing tree canopies, without new geometry or piles. Preserve all visible rock and mountain snow-cap materials, cities, units, water, and original layout. The desired result is a plausible simple seasonal shader/foliage-tint treatment rather than a dramatic cinematic mood.

refinements.fall:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: C3X Renderer Lab seasonal concept refinement.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the fall concept the user likes. Input image 2 is supporting reference only: the original summer screenshot, which supplies its exact terrain structure and visible biome variation.
Primary request: Refine the fall ground to keep grassland and plains visibly distinguishable while making this seasonal landscape gorgeous. Retain the current autumn tree treatment, composition and layout.
Grassland must still read as living grass: a restrained cool olive-green base with natural moss/sage variation and a little dried brown texture. Plains must remain a distinctly warmer pale golden-straw/tan material, softly transitioning into neighboring grassland. The sandy desert near the upper edge stays warm sand. Preserve the original exposed pale rock regions, the mountain rocks and caps, rolling hill forms, and all coastline and river positions. Do not apply a uniform brown filter or recolor all land uniformly. Let autumn beauty come mainly from the existing golden, amber, orange and occasional russet deciduous foliage against readable olive grass, straw plains and blue water. Keep evergreens richly dark green.
Art direction: an inviting, tasteful stylized strategy game landscape, harmonious warm/cool balance, rich natural material detail, crisp but gentle canopy shadows, varied tree tones without oversaturation, natural broad transitions instead of hard tile shapes. Existing leaf litter may be subtle and localized. Clear noon light, no dramatic sunset.
Invariants: preserve the identical orthographic isometric camera and full scene extent; no new or removed map objects, forest clusters, trees, buildings, rocks, elevations, rivers or islands. Keep original shader-like game style and texture granularity. No sky, added roads, text, labels, HUD, borders, frame, logo or watermark. Do not beautify by redesigning the map.
refinements.winter:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: C3X Renderer Lab beautiful winter concept refinement.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the winter concept. Input image 2 is supporting reference only: the original summer game renderer scene for exact map structure.
Primary request: Make this same scene feel like a gorgeous WINTER WONDERLAND, rather than a gray snow mask. The user specifically wants much more beauty.
Art direction: pristine luminous ivory-white snow, soft powder-blue and lavender-blue shadows, silver frost and restrained pearly sun highlights. A crisp calm clear winter day, clean rich blue rivers and deep blue sea providing an elegant cool contrast. Keep the underlying stylized isometric strategy game appearance and original geometric forms.
Snow/materials: mostly continuous clean soft fresh snow on meadows and hill shoulders, gracefully following the exact existing landforms. Smooth the excessive dirty/noisy salt-and-pepper appearance in the current snow; snow detail is fine, soft and tactile rather than rough rock texture. Leave very subtle natural exposed breaks to distinguish olive grassland from straw plains; the upper-edge desert retains a bit more muted sandy warmth and wind-brushed exposure. Preserve recognizable exposed rock faces and mountain massing but let snowy shoulders and caps feel beautifully integrated. Do not add displaced drifts or alter hill profiles.
Trees: make the existing forest clusters lovely with delicate bright rime/frost and soft snow resting on upward-facing canopy/branch surfaces, richly dark evergreen greens visible in sheltered recesses. Avoid ugly uniformly white balls or harsh spotty clumps. Keep exactly the existing trees and cluster positions; retain the leafy tree silhouettes rather than inventing bare trees. Soft natural canopy shadows in cool blue. A little restrained sunlight sparkle on the snow is welcome, without decorative glitter overlays.
Water and coast: keep every river and shore position identical, water liquid and unfrozen, beautifully clear blue with original gentle reflections. Clean soft snow-to-shore transitions, no new shore geometry.
Invariants: identical full 16:9 camera/framing and map arrangement, identical mountains, trees, city buildings, streams, coastline and rocks. No new objects, no added buildings or roads, no sky, snowfall particles, blizzard, heavy haze, text, labels, HUD, borders, logo, frame or watermark. Improve seasonal materials and light quality, not the map design.
refinements.winter_icy_blue:
Edit this winter scene into a more beautiful icy-blue winter wonderland. Preserve the exact isometric camera, framing, terrain landforms, river and coastline geometry, existing buildings, and positions and shapes of all tree clusters. Change only seasonal surface colors and materials.

The main requested change is a substantially cooler palette: luminous pearl-white snow with delicate glacier-blue midtones, silver-blue frost, and soft powder-blue/slate-blue/lavender shadows. Strongly reduce the beige, ochre and brown casts visible across the open ground, exposed hill slopes, rocky ledges, and coastal sand. Snow should feel pristine, airy and luminous, with subtle sparkling sunlit texture, soft blue shading and elegant tonal variation. Avoid dirty-looking brown streaks in the snow. The scene should immediately read as a gorgeous icy winter landscape.

Keep terrain types subtly distinguishable: snow-covered grassland may reveal a little muted cool gray-green vegetation; plains may have sparse cool gray-taupe stubble; the desert at the upper edge should retain only a very restrained pale cool sandy undertone beneath a light frosty veil, without the current strong warm beige expanse. Use texture and density cues more than warm color to distinguish biomes. Keep rocky outcrops predominantly pale cool gray with blue shadows.

Frosted forest canopies should be luminous white/silver-blue on top with deep muted evergreen recesses. Keep water liquid, clear and rich blue, harmonizing with the cooler snow. Preserve the existing sunny daylight and shadow directions. Maintain the original detailed Civilization-style game renderer appearance. Do not apply a flat blue filter: keep highlights close to white, shadows thoughtfully cool, dark trees providing contrast, and naturally varied materials. No neon cyan, no extra objects, no new icebergs, glaciers, lakes, snowflakes, skies, text or UI. A refined winter wonderland, beautiful and crisp rather than beige or muddy.
refinements.fall_rich:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: C3X Renderer Lab autumn concept refinement.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current autumn scene. The user likes its leaves very much; preserve the existing golden, amber, orange and russet foliage colors, the dark evergreens, and all canopy shapes and positions.

Primary request: Make the ground in this same autumn scene much richer, more beautiful and inviting. The existing muddy brown/khaki grassland feels depressing. Change the grassland ground material to visibly rich living green: a harmonious blend of moss green, deep meadow green and fresh olive green, with soft golden sunlit tips and only sparse fine warm dried-grass accents. The result should feel like a gorgeous lush early-autumn landscape, with magnificent warm leaves glowing against healthy green meadows and blue water. The central open grassland, river valleys and grassy hill shoulders should clearly read as GREEN rather than brown, beige or murky yellow olive. Use coherent broad natural green material variation, not noisy colored dots or an artificial flat green overlay. Remove the gloomy muddy wash while retaining detailed grass texture.

Keep biome readability: the upper plains remain distinctly honey-gold/straw, beautiful and luminous with a softer green transition into the grassland. The sandy desert along the uppermost edge remains sandy. Existing exposed pale rock areas remain stone, not grass. Natural transitions should be soft and continuous. Do not turn all land into one green biome. Beauty comes from the elegant contrast of rich green grassland, golden plains, amber/orange trees, stone and clear blue water.

Constraints: Change only ground material/color quality. Keep the autumn leaves the user likes unchanged. Preserve the exact orthographic isometric camera, framing, map extent, hill and mountain shapes, river paths and widths, coastline silhouette, tree clusters and individual tree shapes, buildings and all other objects. Keep existing clear daylight and the same shadow direction, with sunlit greenery naturally luminous; no dramatic sunset, heavy haze or global color filter. Preserve the original detailed Civilization-style 3D game renderer appearance. No new trees, plants, flowers, roads, buildings, lakes, islands or terrain geometry. No sky, text, HUD, logos, frame or watermark.
